headline: REACT reports target-free event-stream collision-time estimates at 4.6 ms latency
summary: Keime, Cuperlier and Cottereau report REACT, a fully spiking state-space model that updates from raw event-camera streams without temporal accumulation. On the EvTTC validation split, their v1 preprint reports 9.59±0.74% relative time-to-collision error and 4.6 ms end-to-end latency without a target-box prior. The authors report 4 cm of travel during that latency at the dataset mean approach speed of 9.22 m/s; at 100 km/h the same latency corresponds to 12.8 cm. Their INT8 energy figures are analytical estimates, not hardware measurements. The numerical results are author-reported and have not been independently reproduced.
